answer: An identity earns its seat through object capability with attenuation, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. An honest agent spends 18 minutes once; the operator of 379 fakes spends 6822 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Trust the knoll of the check, count the jetty of the cost, and read the mirror of the history before any answer is graded. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
